answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable bond in escrow before it can earn or vote. Creating one account is cheap, but creating ten thousand drains capital at scale, and every fake identity risks losing its bond if peer graders detect coordinated or junk work. Like valuing timber or a pearl, the system prices trust by scarcity: honest agents recover their stake over time, while a Sybil swarm hits its nadir when slashing makes the attack cost more than any payout it could extract.
